quote: Started using Galaxium a couple days ago and it's already changed how I build. Instead of manually placing parts I just describe what I want and it's there.
I used to spend hours setting up basic scripts. Galaxium gets me from idea to working prototype in minutes.
The instance tree generation is wild — full ScreenGuis, scripts, everything nested correctly. Feels like pair programming with someone who knows Studio inside out.
Been solo deving for a year and Galaxium is the closest thing to having a teammate. My workflow got so much faster.
Didn't expect an AI tool to actually understand Roblox's instance hierarchy this well. Genuinely useful, not just a gimmick.
Galaxium turned my weekend project from 'maybe someday' into something I actually shipped in two days.
I run a small dev team and Galaxium's become the thing everyone opens first. Cuts our prototyping time down massively.
Honestly surprised by how clean the scripts it writes are. Not spaghetti code, actual structure I'd write myself.
Went from not knowing how RemoteEvents work to having a working shop system in an afternoon. Wild.
The fact it reads my actual DataModel before generating anything is the part that sold me. It just knows what's already there.
